A '''platoon''' in the [[Thirty-eighth Infantry]] of the [[Republic Army]] served in the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Several of the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon's]] members were from the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which led the platoon to name their [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] the [[Sandtusker (walker)|Sandtusker]] after the [[Sandtusker|reptilian scavenger]] of the same name that was native to Tatooine. The Sandtusker carried the platoon through some of the harshest battles of the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The platoon and their walker were first mentioned in the Codex entry for sandtuskers in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sandtusker}}</ref>
